_note: Extra filtering/display rules applied ONLY to the AnyList push (scripts/anylist_push.js). data/plans/<week>_grocery.json and the dashboard are unaffected — they keep every non-pantry_staple ingredient at its recipe-accurate quantity. When new recipes introduce pantry items that should be excluded here, add them to exclude_items (or exclude_keywords_regex if the pattern generalizes). Decided with the user 2026-08-14.
exclude_items: dry sherry, vermouth, or white wine
_kept_ambiguous_note: User explicitly chose to KEEP (not exclude) these groups when asked: nuts & seeds (sliced/toasted almonds, walnut halves, roasted peanuts, sunflower/sesame seeds), non-lentil legumes (chickpeas, kidney beans, canned beans, canned artichoke hearts), briny/pickled condiments (capers, caper brine, kalamata olives, pickled ginger), and coconut milk (2026-08-23: household doesn't keep it on hand, so it must always be pushed).
_unconverted_note: Left at their recipe measurement (cup/etc.) rather than guessed, because the ingredient name is a compound either/or with no single clean produce noun: 'asparagus or green beans', 'carrots or zucchini', 'fresh basil or cilantro', 'shredded or pickled carrots'. Flag to the user if seen on the list.
_category_note: AnyList's categoryMatchId groups items under the app's built-in aisle headers (fetched from userCategoriesResponse — the valid ids are: baby, bakery, beverages, breakfast-and-cereal, condiments-oils-and-salad-dressings, cooking-and-baking, dairy, deli, frozen-foods, grains-pasta-and-side-dishes, health-and-personal-care, household-and-cleaning, meat, pet-supplies, produce, seafood, snacks-cookies-and-candy, soups-and-canned-goods, wine-beer-spirits, other). grocery.json's own sections (produce/dairy-eggs/bakery/frozen) map straightforwardly via section_category_defaults; the catch-all 'pantry' and 'other' sections need per-item mapping since AnyList has no equivalent generic bucket — item_category_map covers every currently-surviving (non-excluded) pantry/other ingredient. A new recipe's pantry/other ingredient not yet in this map falls back to 'other' rather than guessing wrong.
